amount.description: What the customer paid, GST included, in the deposit's currency.

customer_id.description: The customer who paid it: a contact marked as a customer.

date.description: The day the money came into the account.

fx_rate.description: For a deposit in another currency received into an account in that currency: base currency per one unit, as on the bank's advice. Left out, the cascade's rate for the date (ENG-40).

gst_code.description: A part payment only: the GST code of what it pays for, from the sg-gst pack in force on its date, such as SR; its GST is RND-GST-INCL of the amount in the base currency, none before the organisation is GST-registered. A security deposit names none.

kind.description: part_payment: paid ahead for what will be invoiced, so it bears GST when received once the organisation is GST-registered (ENG-45); security: held as security, bearing no GST until it is used as payment (FR-AR-09).

money_account_id.description: The bank, card or wallet account it came into: an active money account in the deposit's currency or in the base currency.

received.description: For a deposit in another currency received into a base-currency account: what the account received, in the base currency. Required then, and only then (LEDGER-27).
